title: NASA Will Spend 843 Million Dollars To Crash The ISS
hook: NASA will spend 843 million dollars to crash the ISS.
closing: Ending a space station costs almost as much as building spacecraft.
question: Will you miss the ISS?

segments.say: The ISS has held people continuously for 24 years, creating humanity's longest home in space.
NASA spends 3 billion dollars yearly on the ISS, making retirement financially unavoidable.
NASA's deorbit vehicle costs 843 million dollars, turning disposal into another major mission.
